name: ^socket\.send$
reason: Bun websocket send; the twin computes and checks the exact frame text.

name: ^socket\.close$
reason: WebSocket close; the twin checks the code and reason it computed.

name: ^readSpecs$
reason: A caller-supplied callback; its value only feeds writes queued as closures and is not read.

name: ^response\.text$
reason: Web Response body read; the text is passed to the parser the twin calls next.

name: ^waitUntil$
reason: Runtime hook that keeps a promise alive; the twin only checks it was handed the cleanup.

name: ^crypto\.randomUUID$
reason: Random id supplied by the host; the twin composes the sandbox id from it.

name: ^reservePlatformSandbox$
reason: Mocked in some executor tests; the twin checks provider, account and key and treats the id it returns as the reservation.
